name: Sofie megarepo (Core + Blueprints + Rundown Editor + Demo Assets)

terminals.name: sofie-core
terminals.command: source scripts/cloud-env.sh && cd ../sofie-core && unset NODE_ENV && yarn dev
terminals.description: Sofie Core dev stack: Meteor backend (3000, DDP/API), Vite WebUI (3005), and job workers. First readiness takes a few minutes; the [TSC] 'Cannot find module meteor/...' lines are expected false positives.

terminals.name: rundown-editor
terminals.description: Sofie Rundown Editor: Express + Socket.IO backend (3010) and Vite frontend (5173). Reads type manifests from the megarepo assets/ via SOFIE_MEGAREPO_ASSETS. 'Core Initialization Error ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3000' is benign when Core is not up.

terminals.name: demo-assets
terminals.description: Demo Assets CasparCG HTML template dev server (8080), e.g. http://localhost:8080/l3d-tema/index.html. Also the Rundown Editor GFX preview target.
